name: Sub Pay Check
office_task: Before a subbie's payment claim is approved, check their licence, insurance, cover and statements are on file and current, file each one, and hold the payment for a named person.
systems_of_record: Xero (the subcontractor's bill, which issues the bill_id)
Gmail (the message each statement or certificate arrived on)
Google Drive (the document store that issues each document_id)
a Google Sheet as the exception desk (exception_id, exception_owner)

emits.write: each statement, licence and certificate of currency filed against the bill_id it supports, by reference to the subbie's facts in the graph
emits.readback: the document store returns the document_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id and the message_id it arrived on; no id back means it was not filed and the pack stays on Hold

emits.write: the bill marked as pack checked, with the as-of, the rule versions cited and the named person who accepted the pack; nothing is paid
emits.readback: GET the bill by bill_id from the ledger returns the pack-checked status, as-of and accepted_by; the status is only stamped after the handover returned ok

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming its owner: a check failed (do not pay), paperwork missing (Hold), a release with no name, or a pack waiting for a named person to accept it
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the bill_id, the check it stopped at and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
